description:
`dev/scripts/ccx1-bench-flock.sh` pins every measured command with `taskset -c 6-11`. On a host without those CPUs `taskset` fails before the command starts, so a documented reproduction cannot run there.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The wrapper takes its CPU list from one documented configuration point, with the committed list as the default for the reference host.
- [hard] REQ-02: The lock protocol and the recorded host observation are unchanged for the default configuration, shown by an ignore-whitespace diff review.
- [hard] REQ-03: `docs/how-to/reproduce-performance-evidence.md` states the configuration point.
title: Benchmark lock wrapper pins to a fixed CPU list
